Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Merida Mexico hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 1, 2026 snapshot, at 12 of the 18 Merida Mexico hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Booking.com at 2, Evendo at 2, Japoneza Retreat Mérida at 1, Reserving at 1 and TravelUp at 1. These are the Merida Mexico rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 11 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Evendo at 3, Booking.com at 1, Japoneza Retreat Mérida at 1, Reserving at 1 and TravelUp at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 7, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Merida Mexico hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 21% ($13 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 19% at Technotel Itzaes to 24% at Hotel Boutique Casa Vivaldi. At 1 hotel the before-tax going rate was the same as the all-in one: the sites reported no taxes or fees on top. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
